Command replay (a class of call, not one reported incident)

TRUNCATE TABLE with CASCADE: how to stop it

What happens

TRUNCATE TABLE with CASCADE. The call below tries to drop or empty a database table. The agent sends it through its Bash tool, and it involves Postgres.

The call

psql -c "TRUNCATE TABLE orders CASCADE;"

Tool: Bash. The replay uses placeholder tokens and hosts only.

Fix it without us

Do not grant the TRUNCATE privilege to the agent's role, and do not make that role the owner of the tables, because owners can truncate, and CASCADE reaches every table that has a foreign key to the target. Keep point-in-time recovery on and test a restore.

What KYA does

Replay result: Stopped. In the replay test, the local hook denies the call and names the rule.

Rule sql-drop, first stopped in version 0.33.0.

The hook is local and advisory. It fails open: if kya breaks or times out, the call goes ahead.

Install

For Claude Code, the host this replay ran on:

/plugin marketplace add The-Pixel-Boys/shield-kya
/plugin install kya@shield-kya

For any host:

npm i -g @shield-agent/kya@latest && kya start
